ui.title: Packbound Expedition
ui.tagline: Every cell is a choice. Every battle tests your build.
ui.expedition_description:
Choose the Armorer or Alchemist. Buy, rotate and craft your inventory across three acts.

Health persists between battles. Inspect the entire enemy build before you commit; routes, money and space shape the expedition.
ui.controls_overview:
Drag with the mouse · Q/E rotate · R reroll · F lock · Space fight/pause
Controller: grid cursor, A confirm, B back, shoulders rotate.
ui.invalid_seed: Enter an integer seed from 0 to 4294967295.
ui.route_hint: Inspect builds and risks. Noncombat nodes cannot be consecutive; the act boss is mandatory.
ui.node_rest_hint: Restore health or transform an item using a defined recipe.
ui.node_event_hint: Trade off resources, health and items.
ui.node_merchant_hint: An extra shop with one free reroll and no combat.
ui.grid_controls:
Drag or click to pick/drop · Q/E or wheel rotate · T store
Controller: D-pad grid, A pick/drop, shoulders rotate, triggers switch zones.

ui.credits_text:
Design and configuration: based on the supplied planning baseline and tables.
Interface, semantic vector icons and sounds: independently generated for this rebuild.
All storage is local; no online account is required.
